title: GENESCO INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Genesco Inc. (GCO), a Nashville-based footwear and accessories retailer, filed an 8-K on April 8, 2026 disclosing that its board adopted a new Short-Term Incentive Plan (STIP) effective for fiscal year 2027, replacing the prior Fourth Amended and Restated EVA Plan. The STIP establishes performance-based cash award structures for eligible employees, with awards tied to financial, operational, and strategic metrics.
key_points: Genesco Inc. board adopted a new Short-Term Incentive Plan (STIP) on April 7, 2026, replacing the Fourth Amended and Restated EVA Plan
STIP is effective for fiscal year 2027 and will remain in effect until amended or terminated by the board
Awards are calculated as 75% of Target Award multiplied by applicable Business Unit or Corporate Multiple, plus 25% multiplied by the Multiple and Performance Plan Percentage
Performance criteria include net earnings, EPS, revenue, gross profit, operating income, cash flow, operating margins, and other measures as determined by the Compensation Committee
Awards have a cap of three times the participant's Target Award
Participants must be full-time active employees on the last day of the performance period and have worked at least 120 days during the period
